subject: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@medsys.de>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@teko.jp>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:46:00 +0100
Subject: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes

Team — looping you in on next steps with MedSys (Lena) and Teko (Kenji). They’ve both agreed in principle to be customer references; we need coordinated regional approvals and language‑specific wording before final publish. High level asks: 

- Get German language review and legal consent from MedSys for the German variant. Lena prefers an inline doc we can sign.
- Confirm any APAC nuance with Kenji — he flagged regulatory phrasing around data residency in JP.
- Finalize logo & quote permissions into the consent matrix.

Soojin — can you own the localization passes (DE/JA) and provide suggested edits by end of day Friday? Marissa — can you prep the public‑facing one‑pager and mark the places where translated quotes should appear? Vivek — please keep track of approvals in the deal record and escalate any procurement asks.

Attaching current EN draft and the consent matrix. 

Attachment: medsys_case_study_draft_EN.docx (docx, 1.1MB)
Attachment: consent_matrix_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@medsys.de>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 13:12:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes

Thanks Hannah — I’ll take the lead on DE/JA. Initial notes after a quick pass on the EN draft: 

- DE: avoid literal translation of marketing idioms ("punchy" CTAs) — MedSys prefers neutral, clinically precise language. I’ll submit a tracked‑change DE draft and a short glossary for clinical terms.
- JP: Kenji’s flag about data residency is important; we should avoid implying data leaves JP. Suggest a short parenthetical clarification that production data was not used in training (if true) and link to our privacy FAQ.

I’ll upload locale drafts to the shared Drive and add a column in consent_matrix_v3 for language‑specific approvals + legal signoff. ETA: Friday EOD (their local time).

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Localization & Content Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@medsys.de>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes

Hannah/Vivek — thanks for coordinating. MedSys is happy to be a reference. A few constraints from our side: 

1) German copy needs a clinical‑accuracy review by our medical writing team. We can provide edits but need at least two business days to review any final DE text.
2) We require a short consent form (one page) that states where logos/quotes will appear and grants permission for translations. We prefer DocuSign.
3) Any claims about data residency or certifications (SOC2 / ISO) need to match our procurement docs — I’ve attached a short checklist.

I’ll ask our legal to review the consent form once you send a DocuSign. Otherwise, proceed with the DE translation draft.

Attachment: medsys_pub_procurement_checks.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

Best,
Lena Müller
Head of Partnerships, MedSys Health GmbH
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@medsys.de>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:21:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes

Hi all — Laura from Legal here. Quick notes: 

- DocuSign is fine. Please use the consent matrix template in Drive (I flagged the sections we always need for translations + sublicensing).
- We need the DE text to be attached as an exhibit to the consent form, or at minimum the DE quote language included verbatim in the DocuSign envelope before signing. That prevents ambiguity about which version was approved.
- For JP/other APAC regions: if wording is materially different (not just translation), we need a separate exhibit.

Hannah/Vivek — when you send the DocuSign, copy legal@redwood.ai or me directly so we can do a quick pre‑review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@medsys.de>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@teko.jp>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:32:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes

Upload complete — I put two files in the Drive: DE tracked changes and JP suggested phrasing. Links below.

- DE draft (tracked): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB-case-study-DE
- JP suggestions (annotated): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB-case-study-JP

Key DE change examples (summary): 
- Replaced "breakthrough" with "weiterentwickelte" in headline for clinical tone.
- Shortened customer quote to remove comparative claims about competitor products.

Kenji — could you confirm the JP phrasing on the data residency parenthetical? If wording needs to be stronger, we’ll prepare a separate exhibit as Laura suggested.

Attachment: logo_guidelines.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

—Soojin
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Multi‑regional reference: consent and German/JP localization notes

Quick update from my side — I’ve: 

- Created the DocuSign envelope using the consent_matrix_v3 template and attached the DE tracked text as Exhibit A. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/EN_Consent_Form_8942
- Logged an activity and updated the deal stage in HubSpot (RDW‑EXP‑8942 -> Contracting).
- Noted the procurement checklist from Lena; I’ll route any procurement/PO asks to finance and cc legal.

Next steps: once Lena’s legal signs the envelope (they should get it Monday CET), we can publish the localized assets to the case study page and schedule the social push. Marissa — can you hold the social copy until signoff?

Thanks everyone — Hannah, please let me know if you want me to escalate timing with the MedSys legal team.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
